name.en: Metal roof, mini-rails on stud bolts or seam clamps (S-5 style)
name.es: Cubierta metálica, mini-rieles sobre espárragos o garras de junta (tipo S-5)

description.en: Mini-rails carried by stud bolts through metal sheet or by seam clamps on standing-seam roofs. Clamp torques live in roof_standing_seam_clamp and the mini-rail profile in roof_accessory_catalogue. Stud bolt through sheet data not found.
description.es: Mini-rieles sostenidos por espárragos a través de chapa metálica o por garras de junta en cubiertas de junta alzada. Los pares de las garras están en roof_standing_seam_clamp y el perfil del mini-riel en roof_accessory_catalogue. Datos del espárrago a través de la chapa no encontrados.

typical_use: Metal roofs (sheet or standing seam) where mini-rails carry modules. Fixing capacity and sheet gauge checks are the designer's responsibility.

materials.material: Aluminium EN AW-6063 T66 (K2 MiniRail 60 Set, see roof_accessory_catalogue)

geometry.description: No sourced spacing or stud pattern. No elements placed.

accessories.name: Mini-rail to S-5 style clamp connection

quantity.note: Count not stated. Bolt and torque are in roof_standing_seam_clamp (bolt_hex_flange_m8x16_s5); not duplicated here.

accessories.note: See roof_standing_seam_clamp for M8-1.25 x 16 hex flange bolt and torque (S-5 guide).

accessories.name: Equipotential bonding for metal roof mini-rail

grounding_bonding: Not found in S-5 guide for clamps or mini-rails.
installation_notes: Clamp installation per S-5 guide: T30 Torx set screw and M8-1.25 x 16 mm hex flange bolt (see roof_standing_seam_clamp).
